Rubriq on Research Square
Your expert companion in academic writing

Accelerate your research with AI optimized for science and built for researchers like you. By connecting your account to Rubriq, you can now use Rubriq’s editing features on your Research Square manuscripts.

Log into your Dashboard to view the Language Quality Score for your manuscripts and connect to Rubriq to download your edited manuscript.

WHAT IS RUBRIQ?

Rubriq is an AI-powered writing assistant designed specifically for academic papers. It provides intelligent suggestions, improves writing structure, and enhances flow to help you produce high-quality academic content.

Streamline your editing process

Rubriq quickly identifies areas in your manuscript that require revision or refinement, saving you time.

Elevate the quality of your academic writing

Rubriq suggests improvements to clarity, precision, and style, so that you communicate your findings more effectively.

Tailor Rubriq's suggestions to your needs

Rubriq allows you to maintain control over your writing by delivering edits as tracked changes, allowing for easy review.

Make a stronger impression

Rubriq refines your language and structure, helping you make a stronger case for your scientific findings. With improved writing, your work will stand out and make a lasting impact.

Research Square lets you share your work early, gain feedback from the community, and start making changes to your manuscript prior to peer review in a journal.
